Configure IP Address
====================

This procedure sets a static IP address so the controller can be accessed on the network.

Before you begin
----------------
* Connect the Ethernet cable
* Have administrator credentials available

Steps
-----
#. Press **Menu**.
#. Select **System**.
#. Select **Network**.
#. Select **Static IP**.
#. Enter the **IP Address**, **Subnet Mask**, and **Gateway**.
#. Select **Save**.

Result
------
The controller restarts its network interface and applies the new settings.
